text:
ross-recruiter: Quick update — Ross here. Candidate Rowan (senior infra eng) accepted verbally but is asking for a band uplift + deferred equity alignment. Proposed cash: total 242k (base 150k / target 42k / sign-on 50k). Asking uplift to E5 and want sign-on 50% at start / 50% at 6mo. Also requested grant effective date moved to 2026-10-01 to align with company performance cycle. Start target 2026-08-15 (flexible +/- 3 weeks).

nina-peopleops: Please upload the offer packet + market comps, and confirm manager sign-off. Also note if sign-on needs gross-up or special tax handling.

tara-hm: Manager sign-off — Tara. This is a high-priority backfill. Manager prefers earlier start; equity alignment requested to avoid mid-cycle cliff confusion. One-off equity date change ok from my side.

ross-recruiter: Packet uploaded: gdrive.com/rowan-offer and gdrive.com/rowan-comps. No gross-up requested initially; sign-on to be paid in USD to candidate US bank. Included competing offer note in DM.

sam-legal: Legal flag — moving grant effective date affects reporting and may require candidate consent form. If we alter effective grant date, equity-ops must confirm plan compliance. Also cross-check tax reporting for staggered sign-on.

mia-finance: Finance needs FY1 cashflow schedule and GL: ENG-CORE-03. If sign-on is split across FY and next fiscal year, show P&L timing. Also confirm whether escrow is preferred for deferred tranche.

comp-committee-bot: Approval request created: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-1012-58. Approvers: nina-peopleops, comp-committee (chair: paula-comp), mia-finance, sam-legal. Status: Pending.

nina-peopleops: Routing to comp committee and marking as "Backfill  equity alignment". Adding 72-hr candidate hold note. @paula-comp please triage.

paula-comp (not in participants list but joins): I'll review today. Two asks: (1) include 3 external market comps + internal parity snapshot; (2) confirm whether uplift consumes the comp uplift pool or comes from headcount budget.

ross-recruiter: Added comps and internal parity snapshot to packet. Uplift proposed from special comp pool (we requested reserve).

sam-legal: If comp committee approves, legal will draft candidate consent for grant date adjustment and review sign-on language for deferred tranche. Equity-ops will need to confirm mechanics.

mia-finance: Tentatively okay to allocate from comp pool but need final numbers by EOD tomorrow to lock forecasting. If uplift approved, finance will map to ENG-CORE-03 and update monthly burn.

nina-peopleops: Thanks everyone. I'll update candidate to request 72-hr hold and will post committee decision here. :thumbsup:
